sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This selection brings together three print assignments with very different viewing conditions. Orrlee's folding brochure had to communicate across multiple narrow panels, while Orgoheart and Rovastra needed immediate product or retail impact at large scale. The common requirement was clear hierarchy that would survive real-world production and viewing distance.
